note: Bundled offline catalogue for the education view (#228 workstream B, #235, #237). Generated by tools/gen_education_config.py from the core registry (core/education.py + core/valuation_levels.json) so it cannot drift: the dated reference, the plain-language concepts, one screened class note per class, the not-advice key and the sourced/dated valuation rows. The served API is CORS-blocked from the static host, so this bundle is the path most visitors see. Do not edit by hand; regenerate.
